question: ______ was/were the mascot(s) of the Women's Asian Hockey Champions Trophy in 2023.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Juhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Juhi** was the official mascot for the **Women's Asian Hockey Champions Trophy 2023**.
 
• The mascot represents **enthusiasm, energy, and the spirit of sportsmanship** associated with the event.
 
• The tournament was held in **Jharkhand, India**, showcasing the rich culture and heritage of the region.
 
• Juhi symbolized the **empowerment of women through sports**, aligning with the theme of the competition.
 
• The mascot's name, Juhi, is inspired by the **popular Indian flower**, which signifies beauty, strength, and resilience.
 
• Juhi not only highlighted the importance of the tournament but also represented **India's commitment to promoting hockey** at the international level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Hansa**__

 __
 
• Hansa is the name of a series of **indigenous aircraft** developed by India.
 
• It is primarily used for **pilot training and sports aviation**.
 
• The Hansa aircraft was developed by the **National Aerospace Laboratories (NAL) & Taneja Aerospace and Aviation Ltd. (TAAL).**
 
• It represents **India's efforts in aviation technology**, but it is unrelated to the Women's Asian Hockey Champions Trophy.
 
 
 
• **Blaze and Tonk**__
 __
 
• Blaze and Tonk were the mascots for the **Tokyo Olympics 2020**.
 
• These mascots were designed to represent **Japanese culture and innovation**.
 
• They symbolize **friendship, harmony, and resilience** but are not associated with the 2023 Women's Asian Hockey Champions Trophy.
 
 
 
• **Yashi**__
 
 
• Yashi is a popular name in India, often associated with **strength and success**.
 
• However, there is no record of Yashi being used as a mascot for any major sports event, including the Women's Asian Hockey Champions Trophy.
